newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresden airport plans Dm300mln terminal upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Dresden airport plans Dm300mln terminal upgrade.

text.p: Dresden Airport said 300 million marks will be invested in expanding capacity to 3.5 million passengers in the year 2000.
A planning application to upgrade a 25 hectare area had been made to the relevant authority, the airport authority said.
A new passenger terminal, additional apron space, a connection to the Dresden S-Bahn or tramway network, a new motorway link and car park were the main features of the plan, it added.
Further expansion of the airport to handle 4.5 million passengers would depend on how demand developed, the authority said.

Last year, 1.67 million passengers flew to and from Dresden airport, a slight fall of 0.9 percent on 1995, figures from the German airports association ADV showed. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
